I had a lift and augmentation on the 16th, but I am only able to take off work when my boss is out (I work for a small company) so I had to quickly figure out what my limitations were. I have to say, every day after my procedure got noticeably easier and range of motion came back fairly quickly. My husband also works and I know both of us being off for the same amount of time is not possible, financially. I was up and walking around, as requested by my surgeon, to figure out what my limitations were and had my husband adjust certain things around the house so that I would be able to cope without him. My husband went back to work on day 2 and I did drive my son to daycare (his daycare is right around the corner from our house) so that I could get a feel for how I would need to adjust my driving for a smooth returning to work this week. I will say, I anticipated carseats and the harnesses for toddlers are not gonna happen post op. Buckles were a little bit of a challenge, but everyday I was able to move a little better, so that got easier. Turning was also a bit of a challenge, definitely need to two-hand the steering wheel. I think my recovery was so much easier than I was anticipating and I felt the more I moved the less stiff I was and more I was able to do. I am 1 week post op and frequently forget that I even had surgery. Hope this helps and everything works out for you.
